Chapter 1023: 29 Two Little Guys? (Requesting Monthly Pass)

Chapter 1023: Chapter 29 Two Little Guys? (Requesting Monthly Pass)

Lin Yuan’s internal universe.

Even though it houses countless citizens of human civilization and numerous alien lives, vast regions still remain unoccupied.

Lin Yuan’s internal universe is built upon the foundation of the Thirteenth-Tier inheritance “Infinite Void.”

Its profound and unimaginable depth ensures that, as long as space is sufficient, it can accommodate nearly anything.

Whoosh!

Whoosh!

Whoosh!!

Dozens of Twelve-Tier beings appeared in a corner, expressions of ecstatic joy on their faces.

“The Galaxy’s strongest? The Galaxy’s strongest is willing to protect me?”

“Hahaha, the Galaxy’s strongest is merciful! I finally have hope to survive this Great Collapse disaster.”

“If I can stay alive, surrendering completely to the Galaxy’s strongest is hardly worth fretting over.”

…

Upon realizing that they had been absorbed into Lin Yuan’s internal universe, all the Twelve-Tier beings were initially overwhelmed with joy.

They had encountered the edges of the Great Collapse and understood its horrors, fully certain that surviving it on their own was simply impossible.

In such dire circumstances, death was almost an inevitability.

Unable to endure the Great Collapse, they would be forced to remain within the universe, ultimately perishing along with its complete destruction.

This is the fate of all Twelve-Tier beings unable to overcome the Great Collapse.

But now, the Galaxy’s strongest has chosen to bring them into his internal universe.

With the protection of the Galaxy’s strongest, their hopes of surviving the Great Collapse had soared exponentially.

However, as the multitude of Twelve-Tier beings took in their surroundings, they froze in astonishment.

“You came in too?”

“The Galaxy’s strongest is willing to protect you as well?”

“Is everyone here?”

The Twelve-Tier beings were bewildered. To their shock, the strongest of all Twelve-Tier beings in the universe, aside from human civilization, had been absorbed into the Galaxy’s strongest’s internal universe.

Realizing this, many of the Twelve-Tier beings could no longer summon the joy they had felt.

With a quick calculation, they determined that Lin Yuan’s internal universe currently housed around eighty Twelve-Tier beings, coupled with countless citizens of human civilization, and a multitude of aliens who had completely sold themselves to human civilization…

On top of that, many Twelve-Tier beings had vast numbers of lives within their own internal universes as well.

This meant that, single-handedly, the Galaxy’s strongest had absorbed all the life within this universe—including the Twelve-Tier beings—into his internal universe, and now intended to survive the Great Collapse with them.

The Twelve-Tier beings were in shock; facing the Great Collapse with so many lives in tow—what unimaginable catastrophe awaited?

The Twelve-Tier beings could neither imagine nor dare to speculate.

During the Great Collapse of the universe, under normal circumstances, all lives would perish along with the destruction, becoming the driving force for the emergence of the next Cosmic Era.

The Twelve-Tier beings are an exception; they possess a narrow chance of survival—if they can endure the Great Collapse, they can live on.

Yet this chance is relative; the more lives a Twelve-Tier being carries, the slimmer their odds of survival.

Now, the Galaxy’s strongest is carrying the entirety of the universe’s life. How could the Origin Source possibly tolerate this?

With countless lives lost as the driving force, after the universe’s Great Collapse, the time required to bring forth the next Cosmic Era would become immeasurably prolonged.

“Can the Galaxy’s strongest truly endure the Great Collapse?”

“I don’t know. Carrying so many lives, he may face the universe’s full-force suppression and backlash.”

“The Galaxy’s strongest… is he truly that confident?”

…

All the Twelve-Tier beings were tense. Now they were tied to the Galaxy’s strongest; if he failed to survive the Great Collapse, they were destined to perish, with no chance of survival.

“You, Tianyu Clan, having fought with human civilization for so many years with enmity as deep as the seas, have the audacity to plead for the Galaxy’s strongest’s protection?”

A Twelve-Tier being glanced at a few Tianyu Clan Ultimates, expressing slight dissatisfaction.

If the Tianyu Clan’s Ultimates hadn’t been taken in, the Galaxy’s strongest might face less pressure from the Great Collapse, and the odds of surviving would be greater.

“And the Insect Race—didn’t you vow eternal enmity with humans? Why have you been taken in as well? Where’s your backbone?”

One after another, the Twelve-Tier beings cast irritated looks at each other, knowing that their survival hung on everything.

“Enough.”

“No need to argue.”

At that moment, a Star Alliance Ultimate spoke up, sweeping a glance at all the Twelve-Tier beings. “Do you truly believe the Galaxy’s strongest cares about the Great Collapse?”

At these words.

The Twelve-Tier beings froze in place.

The Star Alliance Ultimate’s implication was that the Galaxy’s strongest did not care about the Great Collapse?

Among the Twelve-Tier beings present, none had the methods of the two Ultimates from the Robber Clan to discern Lin Yuan’s capabilities clearly, or to assert that he could challenge the Chaos Venerable.

Their understanding of the Galaxy’s strongest was still confined to him being unable to penetrate Path Splitting Realm peak-level defensive treasures.

Under these conditions, they considered the Galaxy’s strongest to have, at best, Mastery Realm strength. Yet a Mastery Realm being, under the universe’s Origin Source’s intense suppression, was not much stronger than those at the Path Splitting Realm.

“Do you think I’m wrong?”

The Star Alliance Ultimate chuckled and continued, “Have any of you noticed how the Galaxy’s strongest’s internal universe differs from ours?”

“Difference?”

One Twelve-Tier being snapped back. In truth, some had already sensed discrepancies upon entering, realizing the Galaxy’s strongest’s internal universe seemed unnaturally stable.

However, their focus had been immediately drawn away by the commotion among other Twelve-Tier beings.

Now, with the Star Alliance Ultimate’s reminder, they began carefully observing the surrounding space-time.
